## Description

Correlation matrices from covariance matrices
in R [@RCoreTeam-2026].
Each exported function has an internal version without input checks
that other projects can copy.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `rhoMatrix` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rhoMatrix) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/rhoMatrix")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "rhoMatrix")
sigmacap <- stats::cov(x = datasets::mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt", "hp")])
RhoofSigma(x = sigmacap)
```
